title: Trade Imports Event Envelope
description: Event envelope for Trade Imports CDP Microservice Architecture

$schema.description: Sample-validator hook: relative path to the event schema. Present on sample artefacts; not part of the runtime event payload.

eventId.description: Unique identifier for deduplication, tracing, and replay

subType.description: Discriminator for aggregate sub-types (e.g., INTRA, CHEDA, DOCOM)

aggregateId.description: Unique identifier for the aggregate instance (compound key format varies by aggregate type)

aggregateVersion.description: Monotonic version for ordering events within an aggregate instance

eventType.description: Fully-qualified event type name (e.g., uk.gov.defra.imports.notification.NotificationCreated). Deliberately not domain-qualified: the same eventType recurs across journeys (an animals and a plants NotificationCreated carry the same value), so consumers discriminate on the (eventType, subType) pair, never on eventType alone.

timestamp.description: ISO 8601 UTC time the business event occurred (YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ss.sssZ milliseconds precision)

data.description: Event-specific payload (structure defined by individual event schemas)

correlationId.description: Correlation identifier propagated from the request boundary

schemaVersion.description: Structural schema version for this event type. Semver-style `MAJOR.MINOR.PATCH`, e.g. `1.0.0`.

schemaUri.description: Reference to the governing event schema definition (e.g., event-submitted-v1.schema.json for live animals submitted, plants-event-submitted-v1.schema.json for plants)

actor.description: The user or service that triggered this event. Sourced from the acting user's identity at the time the event was written to the outbox.

statusChanges.description: Ordered history of status transitions for this aggregate up to and including the current event. Each entry records the status, the instant it changed, and the actor responsible.

actor.description: The user or service that triggered an event.
